items.html: However, in the secret of these two aforementioned couplings in Yetzira and Assiya, I found [something] of Rav Gedalia HaLevi, and I also found in him a certain addition, and it is this. Know that the first coupling, face to face, of ZON of Atzilut, extends to the coupling of Aba and Ima of Yetzira, so that they should couple and give abundance and vitality to ZON of Yetzira, for the existence that they may expand and make the aspect of complete six extremities (VAK) — and they will not be three included in three (Gimmel Kelilan be-Gimmel) — but a Partzuf of Mochin they do not have.
